items.description_en:
Passive: Certain Strike
Empowers your next attack with 250 bonus magical damage and True Strike. Ranged Attackers have +350 bonus range for the attack.
items.description_zh:
被动：必然打击
下次攻击造成250点额外魔法伤害并且拥有克敌机先。远程攻击者攻击时还将获得+350 攻击距离。
items.lore_en: A graceful gift blessed by the goddess of the hunt.
items.lore_zh: 受到追猎女神赐福的优雅馈赠。

items.description_en:
Active: Solitary Disguise
Casts Smoke of Deceit on yourself only that lasts for up to 15 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：单独伪装
只对自己施放诡计之雾，持续15秒。
items.lore_en: Valuable equipment recovered by a young explorer sifting through the flotsam and detritus drifting in the void.
items.lore_zh: 一位年轻的探险家筛查虚空中漂浮的废料和碎石后找到的珍贵装备。

items.description_en:
Active: Create Illusion
Creates an image under your control.

Passive: Illusion Mastery
Increases outgoing damage of all units and illusions controlled by the hero by 6%.
items.description_zh:
主动：制造幻象
制造一个幻象，供你驱使。

被动：精进幻象
所有幻象继承的攻击力提升6%。
items.lore_en: A dashing cape whose creator insists on calling 'Cloak of Apparition' as opposed to his assistant's 'Illusion' drivel.
items.lore_zh: 一件时髦的披风，它的制造者坚持要叫“幻影斗篷”，而他的助手说的是“幻觉”这种蠢话。

items.description_en:
Active: Havoc
Pulls enemies in a 400 range around you, slowing them by 50% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 + 1.5x your str as magical damage.
items.description_zh:
主动：浩劫
牵引自己身边400范围内的敌人，造成50%减速，持续3秒，并造成175 + 1.5 x 自身力量值的魔法伤害。

items.description_en:
Passive: Rejuvenate
When the wearer's health falls below 20%, they will receive a strong dispel and be healed for 1500 health.

Dispel Type: Strong Dispel
items.description_zh:
被动：回春
佩戴者的生命值低于20%时将被施加强驱散，并且被治疗1500点生命。

驱散类型：强驱散

items.lore_en: Three orbs of remarkable power bound within a single scepter.
items.lore_zh: 三个极具威力的宝珠附在一把权杖之上。
notes_en: Grants +24 to each attribute for Universal Heroes.
notes_zh: 对全才英雄提供+24 全属性。

items.description_en:
Passive: Knockback
Knocks back enemies 50 distance and deals 50 pure damage with every attack.
items.description_zh:
被动：击退
每次普通攻击都会击退敌人50距离，并造成50点纯粹伤害。
items.lore_en: A simple design much improved by a master smith's loving hand.
items.lore_zh: 非常朴实的设计，经过一位锻造大师有爱的双手改良后提升颇多。

items.description_en:
Active: Woodland Stride
Create a path of trees behind you for 3 seconds. Trees last up to 15 seconds.

Passive: Tree Walking
Removes movement speed limit and allows free pathing through trees.

Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
items.description_zh:
主动：林地神行
在身后创造一条全是树木的路，持续3秒。树木最多持续15秒。

被动：树木穿行
突破移动速度上限，在树林间可以自由穿行。

多个鞋类物品的移动速度加成不会叠加。

items.description_en: Combines Sange, Yasha and Kaya together.
items.description_zh: 由散华，夜叉和慧光一起合成。

items.description_en:
Active: Greater Demonic Summoning
Summon 2 demonic warriors and 2 demonic archers that last 65 seconds. The Warrior burns mana every hit and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. The Archer has a basic dispel ability with a slow and a passive movement speed aura.
items.description_zh:
主动：召唤大恶魔
召唤2个恶魔战士和2个恶魔射手，持续65秒。战士每次攻击都会燃烧魔法，并且对击杀它的单位造成魔法伤害。射手拥有具有减速效果的弱驱散技能，还有被动的移速光环。
items.lore_en: A record of the final reckoning. With one page torn out.
items.lore_zh: 记载着最终之战。其中一页被人撕下。
notes_en: The Demonic Warrior has 1600 Health, 4 Armor, 40% Magic Resistance, 380 Movement Speed, 134 Attack Damage, 50 Mana Burn on Hit, and deals 800 Damage on Death.
The Demonic Archer has 1300 Health, 4 Armor, 40% Magic Resistance, 425 Movement Speed, 131 Attack Damage, a basic dispel ability with a slow on a 15s Cooldown, and a 9% Bonus Movement Speed Aura.
notes_zh: 恶魔战士拥有1600点生命，4点护甲，40%魔法抗性，380移动速度，134点攻击力，攻击燃烧50点魔法，死亡时造成800点伤害。
恶魔射手拥有1300点生命，4点护甲，40%魔法抗性，425移动速度，131点攻击力，15秒冷却时间具有弱驱散效果的减速和9%移速加成的光环。

items.description_en:
Active: Fallen Sky
Transform into a meteor that strikes down at the target area after 1 seconds in a 315 AoE, stunning enemies for 1.6 seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage every 1 seconds to enemy units and buildings for 6 seconds.

Building Impact Damage: 110
Building Over Time Damage: 60

Non-Building Impact Damage: 150
Non-Building Over Time Damage: 60

Fallen Sky cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
items.description_zh:
主动：天崩
变成一颗陨石，1秒后撞击目标区域，打击315范围内敌人，造成1.6秒眩晕和冲击伤害。对敌方单位和建筑每1秒造成一次伤害，持续6秒。

对建筑冲击伤害：110
对建筑持续伤害：60

对非建筑冲击伤害：150
对非建筑持续伤害：60

受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的伤害后3秒内无法使用。
items.lore_en: One of the few surviving creations of the acolytes of the Wyrmforge.
items.lore_zh: 龙炉的侍僧为数不多的几个幸存造物之一。

items.description_en:
Passive: Plunder
Steals 150 gold from enemy heroes that die within 2400 units. If the wearer is the killer, there is no range limit and an additional 400 gold is stolen.

Passive: Buried Treasure
Gold loss on death reduced by 100%.
items.description_zh:
被动：抢劫
从2400范围内阵亡的敌方英雄身上偷取150金。如果海盗帽的佩戴者是击杀者，那么没有距离限制，而且还会额外偷取400金。

被动：藏宝
死亡时损失的金钱减少100%。
items.lore_en: A salty skulltopper cursed with endless good fortune.
items.lore_zh: 咸味颇重的骷髅礼帽，戴上后会深受财运无穷的诅咒。

items.description_en:
Active: Reset Cooldowns
Reset the cooldown on all items (except Refresher Orb).
items.description_zh:
主动：重置冷却时间
重置所有物品的冷却时间（刷新球除外）。
items.lore_en: The remains of an ancient universe, preserved within a single sphere.
items.lore_zh: 一个上古宇宙的残余，保存在一个天球之内。

items.lore_en: A life-saving jewel bestowed upon a young queen by a kindly vizier.
items.lore_zh: 一件救命的珠宝，一位善良的维齐尔将其献给了一位年轻的女王。

items.lore_en: The sigil blade of the legendary Brother Yhols of Gausra, stripped from its scabbard on the day of his controversial excommunication.
items.lore_zh: 这把徽记之剑曾为一代传奇——高斯瑞的伊荷斯修士所有，后来他遭到排挤被逐出教会时长剑也失去了剑鞘。

items.description_en:
Active: Lesser Avatar
Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage for 2s. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
items.description_zh:
主动：天仙下凡
施加弱驱散。提供60%魔法抗性加成，并且免疫反弹和纯粹伤害，持续2秒。持续时间内敌方技能的负面效果不会生效。

驱散类型：弱驱散
items.lore_en: The trophy from a mighty beast ambushed and slain in the recesses of its own home.
items.lore_zh: 在一只强大野兽的居所深处伏击得手后获得的战利品。

items.description_en:
Passive: Impeding Corruption
Attacks reduce the target's armor and movement speed. Slow amount varies based on whether the wearer is melee or ranged.
items.description_zh:
被动：腐蚀阻碍
攻击会降低目标的护甲和移动速度。减速数值根据携带者为近战或远程而有不同。
items.lore_en: An ingot of chaos suspended in wizard's ether, housed within an arcanist's orb.
items.lore_zh: 一团混沌悬浮在巫师的灵气中，被装进秘术师的灵球里。

items.description_en:
Passive: Level
Attacks deal 35% more damage to buildings.
items.description_zh:
被动：平世
攻击对建筑造成的伤害增加35%。
items.lore_en: A demonic blade that struck the final blow to crack the gates of the Sanctum of Solanas.
items.lore_zh: 魔性十足的战刃，劈开了索拉纳斯圣所的大门。

items.lore_en: Though many desire this brilliant shard for its obvious qualities, a school of study exists to determine the true size and purpose of its incomprehensible whole.
items.lore_zh: 尽管由于肉眼可见的品质，很多人都想得到这块出色的碎片，不过有一门学派还在研究它无限的整体到底是多大的尺寸，又有什么用途。

items.description_en:
Passive: Spell Lifesteal
Heals the wearer for a percentage of spell damage dealt to enemies.
items.description_zh:
被动：技能吸血
佩戴者每次对敌人造成技能伤害都将根据造成伤害的一定百分比回复生命值。
items.lore_en: A mask tuned to sip the arcane bindings that pass between caster and foe.
items.lore_zh: 一副面具，适合从施法者和敌人之间的奥术维系里吸收少许。
notes_en: Does not heal from Pure or Reflected damage.
notes_zh: 纯粹伤害或反弹伤害不会进行治疗。

items.lore_en: An underground arcanist's update of a back-alley classic.
items.lore_zh: 在地下活动的秘术师对经典非法勾当的再度演绎。

items.description_en:
Passive: Witch Blade
Causes your next attack to apply a poison for 4 seconds, slowing by 25% and dealing 0.75x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike.
items.description_zh:
被动：巫师之刃
使下次攻击施加毒素，持续4秒，减缓25%移动速度，并且每秒造成0.75倍智力值的伤害。本次攻击具有克敌机先效果。
items.lore_en: A spiteful blade inadvertently possessed by the soul of its incautious creator.
items.lore_zh: 一把怨毒的战刃，它鲁莽的创造者不慎将自己的灵魂依附在上面。

items.description_en:
Passive: Chipper
Every time you are attacked, you return 30 damage to heroes and 15 damage to creeps.
items.description_zh:
被动：碎裂
每次受到攻击时，反弹30点伤害至英雄，15点伤害至非英雄单位。
items.lore_en: It doesn't look like much, but it's oddly comfy.
items.lore_zh: 看起来并不厚实，但很奇妙地令人感到舒适。
notes_en: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

items.description_en:
Passive: Corrosion
Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2, slows their movement by -16% (-8% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by 18%. Lasts for 3 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：腐蚀
攻击会使目标的护甲减少-2点，远程目标会被减速-16%，近战目标会被减速-8%。生命回复减少18%，持续3秒。
items.lore_en: Seepage from the wounds of a warrior deity, sealed in an arcanist's orb following a campaign of vicious slaughter.
items.lore_zh: 凶残的屠杀战役过后，从战士之神的伤口渗出的液体被封进一个秘术师的宝珠内。
notes_en: Armor reduction does not stack with its components, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.
notes_zh: 护甲降低效果不会与其配件，黯灭或寂灭叠加。

items.description_en:
Active: Cloak
Causes you to become invisible for 6 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：隐形
使自己变为隐形状态，持续6秒。
items.lore_en: A fantastic garment immediately misplaced by its creator upon completion.
items.lore_zh: 神奇的衣服，刚制作完毕就被它的创造者弄丢了。

items.lore_en: Even simple items of elven make seem imbued with inexplicable efficacy.
items.lore_zh: 即使是简单的精灵物事似乎也灌注了莫名其妙的功效。

items.description_en:
Passive: Immolate
Burns enemy units in a 375 unit radius for 40 damage per second. Illusions deal 25 damage per second.
items.description_zh:
被动：献祭
烧灼375范围内的敌方单位，造成40点每秒伤害。幻象造成25点每秒伤害。
items.lore_en: A very fine cloak that plays host to an overly-protective living flame.
items.lore_zh: 非常精良的斗篷，可以承载过度防护的活体火焰。

items.description_en:
Passive: Lifesteal
Heals the attacker for 5 HP on each attack.
items.description_zh:
被动：吸血
攻击者每次攻击都将回复5点生命值。
items.lore_en: Even when discarded with specific purpose and great care, this frightening mask always finds its way onto the face of a new owner.
items.lore_zh: 即使是出于特定的目的和谨慎的态度而遭到丢弃，但这副骇人的面具总有办法让新主人戴上。
notes_en: Grants 1/3rd of the value to each attribute for Universal Heroes.
notes_zh: 对全才英雄提供1/3全属性。

items.description_en:
Passive: Bottled Lightning
Zaps 2 enemy targets within 700 range, dealing 70 damage and a 40% slow for 0.4 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：瓶装闪电
电击700范围内2个敌方单位，造成70点伤害，并减缓40%移动速度，持续0.4秒。
items.lore_en: The accidental byproduct of a spell conjured to entrap a lesser god.
items.lore_zh: 捕捉一个弱小的神明时施下的咒语意外有了副产物。

items.lore_en: A small token imbued with the fortune of the fae in recognition of an intriguing display of mortal kindness.
items.lore_zh: 较小的配饰，为了酬谢凡人不经意间流露出的善意而注入了仙灵的好运。

items.lore_en: Fine and functional foppery for the fashion-forward fighter.
items.lore_zh: 缤纷纨绔绒，纯绚绵绝缎。

items.lore_en: An enchanted blade that long ago raised a hopeless urchin from pauper to king.
items.lore_zh: 一把具有魔力的战刃，多年前让一个无可救药的顽童从乞丐登上王位。

items.description_en:
Passive: Mage Slayer
Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing 35 physical damage per second and causing them to do 40% less spell damage for 3 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：法师克星
攻击敌人时施加一个负面效果，造成每秒35点物理伤害，并且使目标造成的技能伤害降低40%，持续3秒。
items.lore_en: Forged by a secret order in The Third Age of Praxa'cia to fell the False King.
items.lore_zh: 在天瑶城的第三纪元由一个秘密教团打造，意图扳倒冒牌的大帝。

items.description_en:
Active: Overwhelming Blink
Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a 800 AoE take damage equal to 100 + 50% of your strength and an additional 100% over time, and have 50% movement speed slow and 50 attack speed slow for 6 seconds.

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
items.description_zh:
主动：盛势闪光
传送到最远1200距离的位置。

传送后，800范围内所有敌人受到100 + 50%力量值的瞬时伤害，并且额外持续受到总计为100%力量值的伤害，被减缓50%移动速度，降低50攻击速度，持续6秒。

受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的攻击时，盛势闪光将在3秒内无法使用。
items.lore_en: A horrifying dagger forged in the chaos maw and nigh untouchable by mortal hands.
items.lore_zh: 令人生畏的匕首，在混沌之喉中打造，凡人之手几乎无法企及。
notes_en: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.
notes_zh: 快速点击两次会将自己往己方泉水方向传送。

items.description_en:
Active: Swift Blink
Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, you gain 40% phased movement speed and +35 Agility for 6 seconds.

Swift Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
items.description_zh:
主动：迅疾闪光
传送到最远1200距离的位置。

传送后获得40%移动速度加成和相位移动状态，+35点敏捷，持续6秒。

受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的攻击时，迅疾闪光将在3秒内无法使用。
items.lore_en: A cunning blade able to anticipate and enable its bearer's movements.
items.lore_zh: 一把聪颖的战刃，可以预见佩戴者的动向并加以实现。
notes_en: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.
notes_zh: 快速点击两次会将自己往己方泉水方向传送。

items.description_en:
Active: Arcane Blink
Teleport to a target point up to 1400 units away.

After teleportation, you restore 250 health and 100 mana.

Arcane Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
items.description_zh:
主动：秘奥闪光
传送到最远1400距离的位置。

传送后回复250点生命和100点魔法。

受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的攻击时，秘奥闪光将在3秒内无法使用。
items.lore_en: A revitalizing tool to help bear the weight of arcane expenditure.
items.lore_zh: 让人精神焕发的工具，可以帮忙分担施展奥术耗费的精力。
notes_en: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.
notes_zh: 快速点击两次会将自己往己方泉水方向传送。

items.description_en:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades an existing ability or adds a new ability to your hero.
items.description_zh:
被动：技能升级
使英雄升级一个已有技能，或新增一个技能。
items.lore_en: With origins known only to a single wizard, fragments of this impossible crystal are nearly as coveted as the renowned scepter itself.
items.lore_zh: 这块不可思议的水晶只有一名巫师知晓它的起源，而水晶的碎片几乎与赫赫有名的神杖一样让人梦寐以求。

items.description_en:
Active: Cyclone
Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for 2.5 seconds. Cyclone can be cast on yourself, enemy units or allied units. When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of 300.

Enemy units take 50 magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
items.description_zh:
主动：龙卷风
使目标单位被卷入龙卷风中，持续2.5秒，并处于无敌状态。可以对自身、敌方单位或友方单位使用龙卷风。对自身使用后，自身能使龙卷风以300的移速进行移动。

敌方单位落地后将受到50点魔法伤害。
驱散类型：弱驱散
items.lore_en: Proof enough to some that unseen forces manipulate the happenings of the material plane.
items.lore_zh: 对于部分人来说，足以证明看不见的势力操控着现实位面发生的事件。
notes_en: Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
When cast on yourself, the cyclone can be moved anywhere at a speed of 360.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.
notes_zh: 龙卷风可以驱散部分正面和负面状态。
对自身施放时，龙卷风可以任意移动，移动速度为360。
龙卷风持续时间不受状态抗性影响。

items.description_en:
Active: Dominate
Takes control of one neutral target unit and sets its movement speed to 380 and max health to a minimum of 1900. Also provides the unit with +70 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen, +7 armor, and levels up some abilities of the target by 1 level.

Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1900 retain their original max health. Grants the caster the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 250 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
items.description_zh:
主动：支配
控制一个中立单位，其移动速度变为380。被支配单位的最大生命值将不会少于1900点。另外还将使该单位+70点基础攻击力，+12点/秒生命恢复，+4点/秒魔法恢复，+7点护甲并且目标的部分技能等级提升1级。

被支配单位的最大生命值大于1900点时将保留原来的最大生命值。施法者会获得被支配单位的原击杀金钱和经验。被支配单位的击杀奖励为固定250金，并且不会被秒杀非英雄单位的技能直接击杀。

被支配单位受到来自敌方英雄或肉山的伤害后3秒内无法使用支配技能。
items.lore_en: The powerful headpiece of an undead necromancer.
items.lore_zh: 不死的死灵法师留下的可怕头盔。
notes_en: Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
Selling will cause dominated units to die.
notes_zh: 也可以支配敌方线上小兵和召唤单位。
出售会导致支配的单位死亡。

items.description_en:
Passive: Maim
Each attack has a 25% chance to reduce enemy hero movement speed by 20% and attack speed by 60 for 3 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：残废
每次攻击有25%几率减缓敌方英雄20%移动速度，60攻击速度，持续3秒。
items.lore_en: The final, twisted work of a severely pious blacksmith, completed immediately before the taking of his own life.
items.lore_zh: 极其虔诚的铁匠生前最后一个作品，邪性十足，制作甫毕就夺走了他自己的性命。

items.description_en:
Active: Psychic Push
Pushes the target unit away from you 400 distance.
items.description_zh:
主动：通灵推行
将目标单位向自己推远400距离。
items.lore_en: A failed experiment in finer telekinetic control, still fit for other ends.
items.lore_zh: 精进念力控制时发生失败的试验品，在其他方面仍然管用。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

items.description_en:
Passive: Ceremonial Aura
Lowers enemy Status Resistance by 10% and Magic Resistance by 10%.

Radius: 1200
items.description_zh:
被动：祭礼光环
降低敌人10%状态抗性和10%魔法抗性。

作用范围：1200
items.lore_en: One of many items lost in the looting of Zelenwyr's sacred reliquary.
items.lore_zh: 泽伦维尔的圣物箱遭劫时遗失的其中一件物品。

items.description_en:
Active: Shadows
Target an enemy, ally or self. Causes the target to become untargetable from enemies to the caster, but also silenced, muted and disarmed for 4 seconds. Applies a Basic Dispel.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
items.description_zh:
主动：邪影
以敌人、队友或自身为目标。使目标无法被敌人选中，但也会被沉默、锁闭和缴械，持续4秒。施加弱驱散。

驱散类型：弱驱散
items.lore_en: An impossible tome filled with unreadable prose of unknowable thoughts.
items.lore_zh: 一本不可能存在的书，里面全是难以理解的段落，由不可知的想法组成。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

items.description_en:
Passive: Giant's Foot
Can path over any terrain and deals 100% of your strength per second to units you are standing ontop of.
items.description_zh:
被动：巨人之足
可以跨越任何地形，并对自己脚下的单位每秒造成100%力量值的伤害。
items.lore_en: Prized procurement of an otherwise unremarkable ruler of Elze who abdicated his position and vanished.
items.lore_zh: 出价购得的珍贵之物，卖家是厄泽王庭本来并不起眼的统治者，他放弃自己的王位后消失得无影无踪。

items.description_en:
Active: Whip
Grants 25% movement speed when cast on allies, and slows by 25% when cast on enemies. Lasts 4 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：鞭打
对友军使用时提供25%移动速度加成，对敌人使用时减缓25%移动速度。持续4秒。
items.lore_en: Once the favored lash of an infamous broker of pit fighters and other live trade.
items.lore_zh: 原来是臭名昭著的经纪人在从事斗士以及其他行当时青睐的鞭子。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

items.description_en:
Passive: Quicksilver
Grants you a bonus 5% movement speed and 20 attack speed anytime one of your abilities are on cooldown.
items.description_zh:
被动：银闪
有技能在冷却状态中时额外获得5%移动速度加成和20攻击速度加成。
items.lore_en: An enchanted talisman brimming with a mysterious substance.
items.lore_zh: 带有魔力的挂件，闪耀着神秘的光泽。

items.description_en:
Passive: Shroud
Restores mana equal to 25% of incoming enemy spell damage before reductions.

Passive: Eternal Endurance
For every 300 spell damage that equipped hero receives, it gains a stack of Endurance for 5s up to a maximum of 6 charges. Each charge increases Eternal Shroud's magic resistance by 3.5% .
items.description_zh:
被动：法衣
受到敌人的技能伤害在减免前的25%会转化为自身的魔法。

被动：永世耐力
装备的英雄每受到300点技能伤害，就会获得一层持续5秒的叠加效果，最多为6层。每层效果会使永世法衣的魔法抗性提升3.5%。
items.lore_en: A pristine hood that feeds upon strife to empower its owner.
items.lore_zh: 崭新的兜帽，以斗争为能量加强它的主人。

items.name_zh: 阿哈利姆魔晶 - 消耗品
items.description_en:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades an existing ability or adds a new ability to your hero.
items.description_zh:
被动：技能升级
使英雄升级一个已有技能，或新增一个技能。
items.lore_en: With origins known only to a single wizard, fragments of this impossible crystal are nearly as coveted as the renowned scepter itself.
items.lore_zh: 这块不可思议的水晶只有一名巫师知晓它的起源，而水晶的碎片几乎与赫赫有名的神杖一样让人梦寐以求。

items.name_zh: 阿哈利姆福佑 - 肉山
items.description_en:
Passive: Ability Upgrade
Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.
items.description_zh:
被动：技能升级
提升所有英雄的终极技能或基础技能效果。
items.lore_en: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.
items.lore_zh: 这把权杖属于拥有半神之力的法师。

items.description_en:
Passive: Dark Mercy
Your attacks deal 3 more damage to enemies for each 7% HP they are missing.
items.description_zh:
被动：暗黑之仁
敌人每损失7%生命值，对其发动攻击就会额外造成3点伤害。
items.lore_en: An infamous assassin's blade stolen and smuggled out of White Spire after its owner's mysterious demise.
items.lore_zh: 这把武器来自名声狼藉的刺客，在其拥有者神秘的消亡后，遭到盗窃并走私出了白色尖塔。

items.description_en:
Active: Mega Shield
Force Field Aura Grants 25% Damage Reflection for 5 seconds.

Passive: Shield
Grants +4 armor and +8% Magic Resistance to all other allies within 1200 radius.
items.description_zh:
主动：巨盾
盾护光环提供25%伤害反弹，持续5秒。

被动：盾护
向1200范围内所有友军提供+4点护甲和+8%魔法抗性。
items.lore_en: An exquisite piece commissioned by a paranoid monarch who choked on a piece of fruit long before the item saw its intended use.
items.lore_zh: 一件精致的物事，由一位偏执的君王委托打造，在这件物品展现用途前他就被一块水果噎死了。
notes_en: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

items.description_en:
Passive: Hair Trigger
The next time you get attacked by a hero within 400 range, explode dealing 250 damage to all enemies within a 400 radius and causing them to miss 100% of their attacks for 2 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：一触即发
一旦被400范围内的英雄攻击就会爆炸，对400范围内所有敌人造成250点伤害，并施加100%致盲效果，持续2秒。
items.lore_en: One of a set of custom rigs once worn by infamous road agents in the Outlands, its siblings have been lost to misfires and the various tides of time.
items.lore_zh: 曾属于世外之地的拦路强盗身上的一套自制服装，而它的兄弟姐妹早已在打劫的失败和时间的浪潮中失落。

items.description_en:
Active: Shadow Brand
Throws a Mark towards an enemy within 900 range applying a debuff that deals 40 damage every second and provides vision of the unit for 7 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：暗影烙印
向900范围内一个敌人投掷一个面具，施加一个负面效果，造成每秒40点伤害，并获得该单位的视野，持续7秒。
items.lore_en: Those marked for death by the fae shine brightly to all manner of creatures in the shadow realm.
items.lore_zh: 被仙灵标记已死的人对暗影之域中的生物来说都是灿烂的存在。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

items.description_en:
Active: Cleanse
Dispel all enemies and allies in a 300 unit radius.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Subjugate
Your attacks deal bonus magical damage equal to 4% of your target's Max Mana.
items.description_zh:
主动：清洗
驱散300范围内所有敌人和友军。

驱散类型：弱驱散

被动：征服
攻击时额外造成4%目标最大魔法值的伤害。
items.lore_en: With ready access to test subjects, untold cruelties have been dreamed up and loosed upon the world from within the walls of the Tyler Estate.
items.lore_zh: 有了方法测试对象后，泰勒庄园的高墙之内已设想出无穷的暴行，并散播到外面的世界。

items.description_en:
Active: Pig, Out!
Turns your hero into a critter for 3 seconds and gives them +20% Movement Speed.
items.description_zh:
主动：小猪出动！
将拥有者变成一只小动物，持续3秒，并且提供+20%移动速度。
items.lore_en: A makeshift charm misplaced by a peace-loving, addlebrained enchanter.
items.lore_zh: 一个凑合使用的护符，被一个热爱和平又有点糊涂的附魔师弄丢了。

items.description_en:
Active: Vault
Propels your hero forward 300 units. Tumbler's Toy gets disabled for 3 seconds if its owner receives damage from a player source.
items.description_zh:
主动：跳跃
使自身向前推进300距离。拥有者在3秒内受到来自玩家的伤害将无法使用杂技玩具。
items.lore_en: An antique plaything found in the ruins of an Ozenja circus bazaar.
items.lore_zh: 一件古董玩具，是在一个奥泽尼亚杂技团集市的废墟里找到的。

items.description_en:
Passive: Phantom Critical
Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal an additional 80% of the attack's damage as bonus magic damage.
items.description_zh:
被动：幻影暴击
每次攻击都有30%几率造成额外的魔法伤害，数值为攻击伤害的80%。
items.lore_en: The cursed brooch of a fallen guardian who stalks forever between the veil of life and death.
items.lore_zh: 这枚受到诅咒的胸针属于一位堕落的卫士，她永远都在生死之界徘徊。
notes_en: Counts as a Critical Strike for purposes of stacking with other sources of Critical Strike.
Phantom Critical does not work against buildings.
notes_zh: 对于其他来源的致命一击也被视为致命一击效果。
攻击建筑物时不会触发幻影暴击。

items.description_en:
Active: Endurance
Gives +50 attack speed and +15% movement speed to nearby allies for 6 seconds. For the first 1.5 seconds allies are immune to slows.

Radius: 1200

Passive: Swiftness Aura
Grants 15 movement speed and 2.5 health regeneration to allies.

Radius: 1200
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
items.description_zh:
主动：坚韧
为周围友军提供+50攻速加成和+15%移动速度加成，持续6秒。而且最初1.5秒友军不受减速效果影响。

作用范围：1200

被动：迅捷光环
为周围友军提供15移动速度和2.5点/秒生命恢复。

作用范围：1200
多个鞋类物品提供的移动速度加成不叠加。
items.lore_en: Resplendent footwear fashioned for the ancient herald that first dared spread the glory of Stonehall beyond the original borders of its nascent claim.
items.lore_zh: 这双华丽的靴子是为一个古代的先驱打造，是他率先敢于将石堂城的荣光散播到国土的初始边界之外。

items.description_en:
Active: Draw Forth
When targeting an enemy, fire a harpoon at them, that pulls you and the target closer together, up to 35% of the distance between you and your target. If the caster is melee, the hero and target are always pulled to within melee distance of each other. Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.

Passive: Echo Strike
Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a 100% movement slow for 1 seconds on the first strike. Echo Strike cooldown: 5s
items.description_zh:
主动：钩捕
对敌人使用时向其发射一支鱼叉，将自身和目标牵引到更近的位置，最多牵引自身与目标之间距离的35%。近战英雄总是将目标牵引至他们的攻击距离。以树木为目标总是会把自身牵引至该树木。

被动：回音一击
近战攻击可以快速攻击两次。两次攻击都将减缓100%移动速度，第一次持续1秒。回音一击冷却时间：5秒
items.lore_en: A perfect solution for the flight of foes.
items.lore_zh: 完美解决敌人逃跑的问题。

items.description_en:
Active: Verdurous Dale
Target the ground with a 400 radius. Provides health regeneration to all allied units while they are in the area of effect equal to 8 + 25% of the caster's health regeneration at the time of casting. Lasts 8 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：盎然生机
对400范围的地面施放。对作用范围内所有友方单位提供+8点/秒生命恢复 + 25%施法者施法时生命恢复。持续8秒。
items.lore_en: An evergreen sprout treasured by the woodkin and highly coveted by interlopers and their like.
items.lore_zh: 常青的嫩芽，被树人视为珍宝，也遭到入侵者的觊觎。

items.description_en:
Passive: Hound
Attacking from behind slows enemies by 16% (8% if Ranged) and deals 20 more damage. Slow lasts 2 second(s).
items.description_zh:
被动：追逼
从敌人的身后发动攻击会造成16%减速（远程英雄造成8%减速），并且额外造成20点伤害。减速效果持续2秒。
items.lore_en: The gleaming weapon of a tarnished knight haunted by his duties to an unworthy king.
items.lore_zh: 这把带着微光的武器来自一位名声不再的骑士，他常年来都在纠结是否向昏君效劳。

items.description_en:
Passive: Rites of Eloshar
Each time the wearer is attacked, they gain a stack of 0.4 mana regen, up to 5 stacks. Stacks last for 5 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：埃罗莎仪式
每次佩戴者被攻击时都会获得一个0.4点/秒魔法恢复的叠加效果，最多叠加5次。每个叠加效果持续5秒。
items.lore_en: A band that bears effigy of the dark goddess Eloshar's unsleeping eye.
items.lore_zh: 手镯上的雕像刻的是黑暗女神埃罗莎的不眠之眼。

items.description_en:
Active: Ogre Seal Flop
Flop forward like an ogre seal 2 times, dealing 250 damage and slowing enemies in a 275 radius by -100% for 1.5 second on each bounce. 400 bounce distance.
items.description_zh:
主动：食人魔海豹扑打
像食人魔海豹一样向前扑打2次，每次扑打对275范围内敌人造成250点伤害和持续1.5秒的-100%减速。400扑跳距离。

items.description_en:
Passive: Reciprocity
When attacked, the hero counter-attacks a target within their attack range for 80% of their regular attack damage.
items.description_zh:
被动：互换
被攻击后英雄会对攻击距离内的一个目标作出反击，伤害为平常攻击伤害的80%。

items.lore_en: The ring of a cunning court mage who imprisoned a cadre of enemies to serve as his personal mana reserve.
items.lore_zh: 这枚戒指属于一个狡猾的当朝法师，他将一小撮敌人囚禁后用作他私人的法力储备。

items.description_en:
Passive: Splitshot
Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 2 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.
items.description_zh:
被动：分裂射击
远程攻击有30%的概率向非原攻击目标的前方120度角内、攻击距离+150距离内的最多2个附近敌人发射额外弹道。额外弹道造成20 + 75%普通攻击伤害，并且不会触发击中效果。主攻击造成20 + 100%普通攻击伤害。
items.lore_en: An impressive kit of trigger enhancements born in an aging assassin's idle mind.
items.lore_zh: 加强扳机的出色器具，源自一位年迈的刺客闲暇时的想法。

items.description_en:
Active: Imbrue
Consume health to temporarily gain 25 damage for 8 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：浸血
消耗生命值，临时获得25点攻击力。持续8秒。
items.lore_en: A sinister shiv that grants favor to those willing to stain its blade with a sacrifice of their own blood.
items.lore_zh: 一把险恶的小刀，如果自愿在刀刃上涂上自己鲜血将会得到它的帮助。

items.description_en:
Active: Dead Shot
Fires a ghostly bullet at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes it will deal 300 damage and slow the target by -100% for 0.5 seconds, then ricochet in the vector-targeted direction. The ricochet will damage all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet will be feared for 2 seconds in the direction of the shot.
items.description_zh:
主动：弹无虚发
向一个敌方单位或一棵树发射一颗幽灵子弹。子弹击中时将会造成300点伤害并减缓目标-100%移动速度，持续0.5秒，然后沿矢量目标的方向弹去。跳弹将会对穿过的所有单位造成伤害，击中英雄后停下。被跳弹击中的英雄会被恐惧，朝射击方向狂奔2秒。
items.lore_en: One to deliver the body, the other to claim the soul.
items.lore_zh: 一把拯救肉体，另一把夺取灵魂。
notes_en: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel 1x Dead Shot's cast range.
notes_zh: 被恐惧的敌人为相位状态，无法被减速。
跳弹的行进距离为弹无虚发施法距离的1倍。

items.description_en:
Active: Suppress
Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for 4 seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and 40% slow resistance for 4 seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.

Both movement speed reduction and increase start at 100% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Manabreak
Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana.

Illusions do not burn mana.
items.description_zh:
主动：抑制
同时驱散佩戴者和目标。敌方目标会被减速4秒，友方目标则会提升移动速度和40%减速抗性，持续4秒。施法者总是会获得友军的加成效果。

移动速度减缓和提升效果在状态持续时间内初始均为100%，并且逐渐减少至0。
驱散类型：弱驱散

被动：破法
每次攻击将燃烧目标40点魔法，而且每燃烧一点魔法都会造成1点物理伤害。

幻象不会燃烧魔法。
items.lore_en: Once entrusted to an Apostle General of the Rumusque Faithful's expeditionary force.
items.lore_zh: 曾被托付给鲁姆斯克信徒远征军的使徒将军。

items.description_en:
Passive: Empower Spell
The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 150 bonus damage to the target and slows them by 30% for 3s.
items.description_zh:
被动：法术强化
下个对敌人施放的单体技能会单独对目标造成150点额外伤害，并且减缓30%移动速度，持续3秒。
items.lore_en: An amulet overflowing with powerful magics.
items.lore_zh: 洋溢着强大魔力的护身符。

items.lore_en: A crown that can never be removed.
items.lore_zh: 一顶永远无法摘下的冠冕。

items.description_en:
Use: Throw Grenade
Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take 50 damage on impact, and be slowed by -15% and take 15 damage every 1s for 5 seconds. Radius 300.
items.description_zh:
主动：投掷榴弹
向目标区域投掷一枚榴弹。区域内敌人被击中时受到50点伤害，减速-15%并且每1秒受到15点伤害，持续5秒。
items.lore_en: Both the hunter and the hunted must pay the blood price.
items.lore_zh: 猎人和猎物都必须付出血的代价。

items.description_en:
Passive: Courage
Provides 10 damage when the hero is above 50% Health, and 5 armor when they are below that threshold.
items.description_zh:
被动：勇气
在拥有者血量高于50%时提供10点攻击力，低于该临界值时提供5点护甲。
items.lore_en: A common battle charm in the armies that served the Children of Light.
items.lore_zh: 为光之子效力的军队中常见的战斗护身符。

items.lore_en: A source of spiritual and physical nourishment.
items.lore_zh: 滋养精神和身体的源泉。

items.description_en:
Active: Protect
When cast on an ally, grants them a physical damage barrier that absorbs 250 damage. Duration: 7s.
items.description_zh:
主动：保护
对友军施放后施加可以吸收250点物理伤害的护盾 。持续时间：7秒。
items.lore_en: Devised by a wizard who made one too many enemies.
items.lore_zh: 一位树敌过多的巫师设计之物。

items.description_en:
Use: Scrumptious
Try me!
items.description_zh:
使用：可口
倒是吃啊！
items.lore_en: First there was the Belt of Strength. Then there were the Boots of Travel. Now, at long last, the Block of Cheese.
items.lore_zh: 一开始有力量腰带。然后有远行鞋。现在，终于有了，奶酪块。

items.description_en:
Passive: Ancient Power
Grants 50 extra bonus damage as long as the unit is within 2000 range of an ancient.
items.description_zh:
被动：遗迹之力
位于一座遗迹的2000范围内将额外获得50点攻击力。

items.description_en:
Passive: Bubbled Up
Equipped Hero has a 100 HP Barrier against enemy damage. Barrier fully regenerates after not receiving damage for 8 seconds. Self-inflicted damage bypasses the barrier.
items.description_zh:
被动：冒泡
装备的英雄拥有一个可吸收敌方伤害的100点生命的护盾。 8秒内没有受到伤害后，护盾将恢复至满血。护盾不会吸收自残伤害。

items.description_en:
Passive: Tunnel Vision
Equipped Hero has their daytime vision reduced by 15% but their Spell damage increased by 10%.
items.description_zh:
被动：孔中窥人
佩戴者的白天视野减少15%，但是技能伤害提升10%。
items.lore_en: The air that passes through this amulet makes a dreadful sound.
items.lore_zh: 空气穿过这个护符时会发出可怕的声音。

items.description_en:
Passive: Glass Cannon
Hero takes 6% more damage from all sources.

Passive: Glassify
When attacking a hero, apply a debuff increasing the damage received by that hero by 12% for 5 seconds. Only one target can be affected by Glassify at the same time.
items.description_zh:
被动：玻璃大炮
英雄受到的所有来源伤害均增加6%。

被动：玻璃化
攻击英雄时会施加负面效果，使他们承受的所有伤害增加12%，持续5秒。同一时间只有一个敌人会受到玻璃化的作用。

items.description_en:
Passive: Free Bird
When equipped hero is below 30% HP, they gain flying movement.
items.description_zh:
被动：轻如鸿毛
装备的英雄血量低于30%时获得飞行移动状态。

items.description_en:
Passive: Unwavering
Hero's Max Health is set to 1800 and can't be altered by other effects or attributes.
items.description_zh:
被动：坚毅
英雄的最大生命值将定在1800点，不会因其他效果或属性而改变。

items.description_en:
Active: Lightbreak
Produce a brilliant flash of light that destroys trees in a 325 AoE.

Passive: Unclouded
Provides wearer with health regeneration during the day and mana regeneration during the night. When within a 200 distance of any trees, health and mana regeneration are decreased by 75%.
items.description_zh:
主动：变光
闪现一道强光，摧毁325范围内的树木。

被动：明朗
白天为佩戴者提供生命恢复，夜间提供魔法恢复。200距离内存在树木时，生命和魔法恢复减少75%。

items.description_en:
Passive: Reverberate
After taking 220 damage from any source, the wearer fires a projectile at up to 2 random enemies in a 600 radius, prioritizing heroes, that deal 90 physical damage and slow the targets movement and attack speed by 100% for 0.2s.
items.description_zh:
被动：回荡
受到任意来源的220点伤害后，佩戴者对附近600范围内最多2个随机敌人发射一个弹道，以英雄优先，造成90点物理伤害并降低目标100%移动和攻击速度，持续0.2秒。
notes_en: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

items.description_en:
Use: Profane Knowledge
Hero kills and assists empower the Black Grimoire, granting it charges. Right-click to consume and grant 200 experience per charge. Starts on cooldown.
This item cannot be dropped.
items.description_zh:
使用：异教学识
英雄击杀和助攻会增强黑暗魔典，使其获得能量点数。右键点击后将其消耗，每点能量提供200经验。一开始为冷却状态。
这件物品无法丢弃。

items.description_en: This item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack but can be put into normal inventory slots. When the owner dies, 100% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.
items.description_zh: 这件物品无法丢弃或放在背包里，但是可以放到主物品栏里。拥有者阵亡时，死亡损失金钱的100%会加入到该物品中，物品被消耗后将退回这些金钱。右键点击可以消耗这件物品，并将其永久移除。

items.description_en:
Active: Eternal Chains
Roots all enemies in a 400 radius for 2 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：永恒锁链
缠绕目标400范围内所有敌人，持续2秒。
items.lore_en: Bindings forged by impossible means to leash an ancient evil.
items.lore_zh: 以不可能的手段铸就的束缚之物，为了限制一个上古魔物。
notes_en: AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.
notes_zh: 多个裂隙之石或升级物品的作用范围加成不会叠加。

items.description_en:
Passive: Frost
Your attacks slow the target's movement by -13% (-6% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by 15%. Lasts for 3 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：冰霜
攻击使远程目标被减速-13%，近战目标被减速-6%。生命回复减少15%。持续3秒。
items.lore_en: Slowly growing since the universe began, it will envelop everything when it ends.
items.lore_zh: 在宇宙伊始就缓慢成长，到了成长完毕的时候它将覆盖万物。

notes_en: Does not stack with Movement Speed bonuses from boots
notes_zh: 不会与鞋类物品的移动速度加成叠加

notes_en: Grants +24 to each attribute for Universal Heroes.
notes_zh: 对全才英雄提供+24 全属性。

items.description_en:
Passive: Relentless
Increases slow resistance by 50%. This bonus is reduced by 10% for every enemy hero within the wearer's attack radius.
items.description_zh:
被动：不屈
减速抗性提升50%。佩戴者的攻击距离内每出现一名敌方英雄就会使这个加成效果减少10%。
items.lore_en: A serpent's eye the size of a melon (and just as moist).
items.lore_zh: 巨蟒之眼大如蜜瓜（湿度一样）。

items.description_en:
Active: Bottoms Up
Restores 70 + 3% of the caster's maximum mana over 6 seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive: Fill Up
Cooldown Speed of Mana Draught is increased by 30% while in water.
items.description_zh:
主动：一饮而尽
在6秒内回复70点魔法 + 3%施法者最大魔法值。承受来自敌方英雄或肉山的伤害会使效果提前结束。

按住Ctrl键可以对友方英雄使用。

被动：填补
站立在水里时魔力药水的冷却速度增加30%。
items.lore_en: A refreshing drink best shared with friends.
items.lore_zh: 让人为之一振的饮料，最适合与朋友分享。

items.description_en:
Active: Flay
Embeds thorns into all enemies in a 200 unit radius. Affected units take additional damage when attacked for 10 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：剥皮
把荆棘刺入200范围内所有敌人。在10秒内，他们被攻击时都会承受额外伤害。
items.lore_en: The Fae horticulturists of Revtel are known to push the boundaries of both cross pollination and safety.
items.lore_zh: 众所周知，瑞文特尔的仙灵园艺师们不断突破异花授粉和安全的界限。

items.description_en:
Active: Hobble
Hits an enemy for 25 damage, then slows them by 50% and reduces Health Restoration by 40% for 4 seconds. The slow gradually fades over the duration of the spell.
items.description_zh:
主动：蹒跚
击中敌人时造成25点伤害，然后减缓他们50%移动速度，生命回复减少40%，持续4秒。减速效果会在技能持续时间内逐渐减弱。
items.lore_en: The ever-weeping woodgrain of this crossbow coats every bolt in a potent but short-lived narcotic sap.
items.lore_zh: 这把弩的木纹上不断渗出树浆，给每支箭都覆盖上强效但短暂的麻醉汁液。

items.description_en:
Active: Cyclonic Shield
Envelops the caster in an all damage barrier that absorbs 75% of incoming damage up to a max of 225. Lasts for up to 10 seconds and while the barrier is active you have 50% Slow Resistance.
items.description_zh:
主动：飓风护盾
把施法者包裹在225点全伤害护盾中，抵挡75%的所受伤害。最多持续10秒，生效时护盾还会提供50%减速抗性。
items.lore_en: If one truly listens, they can always rely upon the wind to make its will known.
items.lore_zh: 如果能静下心来倾听，就能依靠风来传达自己的意愿。

items.description_en:
Passive: Beat the Crowd
Your next attack deals an additional 120 magic damage and splashes to units within 250 units for 50% of the original attack's damage plus the additional magic damage.
items.description_zh:
被动：殴击人群
下次攻击会额外造成120点魔法伤害，并溅射给250范围内所有敌人，造成攻击伤害和额外魔法伤害的50%。
items.lore_en: A 'harmless' prank that went entirely too far.
items.lore_zh: “无害”的恶作剧，但实在是玩过火了。

items.description_en:
Passive: Burn Through
Instances of magic damage from spells over 60 ignites enemies, causing them to take 80 magic damage over 6 seconds. Burn damage against non-hero targets is decreased by 50%.
items.description_zh:
被动：烧蚀
单次魔法伤害超过60点会使敌人着火，使他们在6秒内受到80点魔法伤害。对非英雄目标的烧蚀伤害减少50%。
items.lore_en: To torture a magic user, one must devise means far beyond the mundane.
items.lore_zh: 想要折磨魔法的使用者，必须想出非常规的手段。
notes_en: Will not ignite enemies that are more than 2000 range away.
notes_zh: 不会点燃2000距离以外的敌人。

items.description_en:
Passive: Gut 'Em
Attacks have a 20% chance to have True Strike and deal 8% of the target's current health as bonus physical damage. Deals a flat bonus of 200 against Roshan.
items.description_zh:
被动：悍劲
攻击拥有20%几率触发克敌机先，并且造成额外物理伤害，数值为8%目标当前生命值。攻击对肉山触发时总是造成固定200点额外伤害。
items.lore_en: Too dangerous for taskwork, this blade's only purpose is vile murder.
items.lore_zh: 这把刀用来执行任务太过危险，它唯一的用途就是卑鄙的谋杀。

items.description_en:
Active: Ribbit
Increases the health regeneration of a target ally by 8 for 14 seconds. While standing in water, the blessed unit also moves 10% faster.
items.description_zh:
主动：呱呱
目标友军的生命恢复提升8点/秒，持续14秒。在水中时，受到福佑的单位还会加速10%。
items.lore_en: A tiny trinket that wriggles when wet.
items.lore_zh: 遇水就会扭动的小饰品。

items.description_en:
Passive: Keen Eye
Increases cast range by 100 and attack range by 100 (Melee & Ranged). Taking over 25 damage from a player controlled source or Roshan disables this effect for 6 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：锐利目光
施法距离提升100，攻击距离提升100（近战/远程）。受到来自玩家控制单位或肉山的伤害超过25点会使该效果在6秒内无效。
items.lore_en: Deadly refinement.
items.lore_zh: 致命的精进。

items.description_en:
Active: Retribution
For the next 6 seconds, 75% of damage taken by the caster is reflected to the target unit as physical damage if they are within 1200 units away.
items.description_zh:
主动：报应
在接下来6秒内施法者所受伤害的75%会作为物理伤害反弹至目标单位，只要他们还在1200距离内。
items.lore_en: There are generals that care far less about the survival of their troops than the destruction of their enemies.
items.lore_zh: 世上就是有那种不关心部下死活，只想着消灭敌人的将军。
notes_en: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

items.description_en: Collect to craft new Neutral Items.
items.description_zh: 收集后可制作新的中立物品。

items.description_en:
Active: One for the Road
Increases movement speed of all allied units by 10% in a 1000 unit radius around the caster for 6 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：临行干杯
提升施法者附近1000范围内所有友方单位10%的移动速度，持续6秒。
items.lore_en: The Kobold King will sip when he damn well pleases.
items.lore_zh: 狗头人之王只要开心了就会喝一口。

items.description_en:
Passive: Hidden Potential
Neutral Artifacts you craft while holding a Dormant Curio have their potency increased by 30%.
items.description_zh:
被动：隐藏潜能
拥有休眠珍品时打造的中立物品会提升30%威力。
items.lore_en: Everyone has an idea, but no one has a clue.
items.lore_zh: 每个人都有想法，但没有人有头绪。
notes_en: Certain stats on the next artifact will be amplified. Will not amplify cooldown, mana cost, or cast range.
notes_zh: 下一件宝物的特定属性会被增强。不会增强冷却时间、魔法消耗和施法距离。

items.description_en:
Passive: Veiled
When falling below 50% HP, gain 150% evasion for 5 seconds. While active, dodging an attack decreases the evasion bonus by 75% of its current value.

Passive: Last Caress
Veiled cooldown is only reset if the wearer dies or kills an enemy hero.
items.description_zh:
被动：蒙纱
每当生命值低于50%就会获得150% 闪避加成，持续5秒。每次成功闪避攻击后这个闪避效果就会减少当前数值的75%。

被动：临终关怀
蒙纱的冷却时间只会在佩戴者阵亡或者击杀一名敌方英雄后重置。
items.lore_en: A pall that draped the sarcophagus of the First Sister.
items.lore_zh: 这面棺罩原先盖着魅影之纱大长老的石棺。
notes_en: Does not trigger from damage by non-player controlled creeps
notes_zh: 受到来自非玩家控制的非英雄单位的伤害不会触发。

items.description_en:
Active: Pollinate
Spreads pollen on all enemy units in a 900 unit radius for 9 seconds, decreasing their health restoration by 50% and dealing damage per second, the total equal to 9% of their maximum health.
items.description_zh:
主动：授粉
把花粉播撒给所有900范围内的所有敌方单位，降低50%生命回复，持续9秒，并且在持续时间内造成每秒伤害，总数值为他们的9%最大生命值。
items.lore_en: Very dangerous. Very difficult to obtain more.
items.lore_zh: 非常危险。很难去获得更多。
notes_en: Damage is non-lethal and classified as HP Loss.
notes_zh: 伤害不会致死，被归为生命损失。

items.description_en:
Active: Self-Exile
Makes the caster completely invulnerable and disabled for 0.7 seconds. When returning to the world, the caster takes 5% of their maximum health as damage.
items.description_zh:
主动：自我放逐
使施法者无敌且被控制，持续0.7秒。施法者回归时会受到5%最大生命值的伤害。
items.lore_en: Proof that the lone sentinel was not always so.
items.lore_zh: 独孤的哨卫并非总是如此的证明。
notes_en: Damage taken when returning is non-lethal and disables Blink Dagger and other items that are muted upon taking damage.
notes_zh: 承受的回归伤害不会致死，会禁用闪烁匕首和其他受到伤害时会被锁闭的物品。

items.description_en:
Passive: Blood Invocation
Spells have a 20% larger Area of Effect, but now additionally cost health equal to 35% of their mana cost.
items.description_zh:
被动：血咒
技能范围提升20%，但是现在还会消耗生命值，数值为魔法消耗的35%。
items.lore_en: The gateway to a lost lineage of power, unlocked only with blood.
items.lore_zh: 通往失落血脉的门户，只有鲜血才能打开。

items.description_en:
Passive: Crushing Blow
Empowers the next attack to be a critical hit dealing 150% damage. Hitting an enemy with an empowered attack temporarily decreases their movement speed by 10%, attack speed by 15%, and cast speed by 20% for 3 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：灭顶一击
下次攻击是致命一击，造成150%伤害。击中敌人后会暂时减缓他们10%移动速度、15%攻击速度和20%施法速度，持续3秒。
items.lore_en: Crude but smashingly effective.
items.lore_zh: 粗糙但效果很猛。

items.description_en:
Passive: Exalted
Increases outgoing damage by 20%. Dying permanently disables this Neutral Item and the current Enchantment is lost.
items.description_zh:
被动：尊崇
伤害输出提升20%。阵亡后这件中立物品会永久失效，而且失去当前附魔。
items.lore_en: So magnificent, it cannot abide failure.
items.lore_zh: 太过耀眼，它无法忍受失败。

items.description_en:
Passive: Fallen
You have died and thus get nothing.
items.description_zh:
被动：堕落
你已经阵亡过，因此不会获得任何东西。
items.lore_en: It cannot abide failure.
items.lore_zh: 它无法忍受失败。

items.description_en: Contains gold
items.description_zh: 内有黄金

items.description_en:
Passive: Loaded
Increases your base damage maximum by 6. When calculating your base damage or creep bounty from last hits, the value is computed 2 times and the highest value is taken.
items.description_zh:
被动：欺诈
最高基础攻击力提升6点。在计算佩戴者针对正补的基础伤害或小兵赏金时，数值会计算2次，并取较高值。

items.description_en:
Active: Shield Wall
Reduce your own movement speed by 20 to provide a 160 physical damage barrier to allied player controlled targets in a 800 unit radius. Lasts for 6 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：盾墙
你的移动速度降低20，向800范围内玩家控制的友方目标提供一个160点物理伤害护盾。持续6秒。

items.description_en:
Active: Refract
Spend 8% of your current life total to create a full health illusion that lasts for 20 seconds. The illusion has 60% outgoing damage and takes 200% of incoming damage.
items.description_zh:
主动：折射
消耗自身8%当前生命值，制造一个满血的幻象，持续20秒。幻象造成60%伤害，承受200%伤害。

items.description_en:
Active: Pupate
Enter into an insect form for 5 seconds, increasing magic resistance by 50% and movement speed by 20%. While an insect, your size is decreased and your armor is reduced by 45%.
items.description_zh:
主动：化蛹
进入昆虫形态，持续5秒，魔法抗性提升50%，移动速度提升20%。在昆虫形态下模型大小减少，护甲减少45%。

items.description_en:
Active: False Flight
Gain 50% slow resistance, phased movement, and 35% evasion for 6.5 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：飞天之幻
提供50%减速抗性、相位移动和35%闪避，持续6.5秒。

items.description_en:
Active: Bloodthirst
Gain 15% base damage and 30 attack speed for 6 seconds.

Passive: Bloodrush
Enemy heroes dying within 1500 units reset the cooldown of Bloodthirst.
items.description_zh:
主动：嗜血渴望
获得15%基础攻击力，30攻击速度，持续6秒。

被动：鲜血之激
只要敌方英雄在1500范围内阵亡，嗜血渴望的冷却时间就会重置。

items.lore_en: A symbol of favor bestowed upon the high priestess of Selemene.
items.lore_zh: 恩泽的象征，授予了赛莉蒙妮的女祭司。

items.description_en:
Toggle: Flip
Toggle to convert 30% of your Max Health to Max Mana, or 30% of your Max Mana to Max Health.
items.description_zh:
切换：翻转
切换后把30%默认最大生命值转化为最大魔法值，或者把30%默认最大魔法值转化为最大生命值。

items.description_en:
Use: Place Banner
Creates a banner at the target location. Lane creeps in the area of effect become damage immune while the Banner is up. Lasts 120 seconds.

Can be destroyed. Melee hero attacks deal 2x damage to the banner.
items.description_zh:
使用：放置战旗
在目标地点创造一面旗帜。战旗立起后作用范围内的小兵将免疫伤害。战旗持续120秒。

可以被摧毁。近战英雄对战旗造成2倍伤害。

items.description_en:
Passive: Witch Blade
Causes your next attack to have true strike, apply a poison for 4 seconds, slowing by 25% and dealing 0.75x your intelligence as damage every second.

Passive: Magic Corruption
Your attacks reduce the enemy's Magic resistance by 20% for 4 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：巫师之刃
使下次攻击具有克敌机先效果，并且会施加毒素，持续4秒，减缓25%移动速度，并且每秒造成0.75倍智力值的伤害。

被动：法力腐蚀
攻击会降低敌人20%魔法抗性，持续4秒。
items.lore_en: Warning: There is no antidote if picked up by the wrong end.
items.lore_zh: 警告：抓到另一头将无药可救。

items.description_en:
Passive: Empower Spell
The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate 250 additional damage, disables their passives, and slows their movement speed by 30% for 4s.
items.description_zh:
被动：法术强化
下个对敌人施放的单体技能会单独对目标造成250点额外伤害，禁用其被动技能，并且减缓30%移动速度，持续4秒。
items.lore_en: A blade sharp enough to slice through magic itself.
items.lore_zh: 锋利至极的刀刃，足以斩开魔法本身。
notes_en: The slow debuff is dispellable.
The break debuff is not dispellable.
notes_zh: 减速的负面效果可以被驱散。
破坏的负面效果不能被驱散。

notes_en: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.
notes_zh: 能与其他提高魔法抗性的技能叠加。

items.description_en:
Passive: Forbidden Knowledge
When consumed, increases Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by 25% of its current value at the time of consumption, and increases the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one. All values except for Mana Cost scale by 50% of the difference between their existing levels for the additional level
items.description_zh:
主动：禁忌学识
消耗后寒冬飞龙的基础智力提升，数值为消耗时当前数值的25%，并且一个基础技能的当前和最高等级均提升一级。最高级的所有技能数值会提升3级和4级差值的50%，魔法消耗除外。

items.description_en:
Active: Soul Release
Provides 40 health regeneration when cast on allies.

Can be ground targeted to lie dormant for up to 15s and attach to the first enemy that comes within 450 radius. When on enemies, deals 25 damage per second and provides True Sight over them and shares their vision with the wearer's team.

Lasts 8 seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within 1500 units.
items.description_zh:
主动：灵魂释放
对友方单位施放时提供40点/秒生命恢复。

可以对地面施放，使其潜伏最多15秒并附着在第一个进入450范围的敌人。对敌方单位施放时造成25点每秒伤害，并且提供敌人的真实视域，与佩戴者全队共享他们的视野。

持续8秒。

每次1500范围内有敌方英雄阵亡时获得能量。
notes_en: Empty distillers gain 2 charges.
Only the closest Essence Distiller to the dying hero will gain a charge.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
While dormant, provides vision in 450 radius. Vision lingers for 0.5s after latching.
notes_zh: 点数为0的灵器将获得2点能量。
只有距离阵亡英雄最近的精之灵器才会获得一点能量。
如果友方单位被敌方英雄或肉山攻击，效果将会消失。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
潜伏时提供450范围的视野。附着后视野还会粘滞0.5秒。

items.description_en:
Passive: Hallowed
Gain a charge every 4s, up to a maximum of 3 charges. Upon gaining a charge, your movement speed is increased by 15% for 5s.

Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan, consume all charges to gain an all damage barrier for 5s that absorbs 120 damage per charge (360 max).
items.description_zh:
被动：神圣化
每4秒获得一点能量，最多为3点。获得一点能量时，移动速度提升15%，持续5秒。

只要受到来自玩家控制来源或肉山的伤害，所有能量都会被消耗，并获得全伤害护盾，持续5秒，每点能量可以吸收120点伤害（最高为360点）。
notes_en: Charges cannot be gained for 4s after you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan.
Self-damage and HP Loss damage cannot remove charges.
Movement speed buff does not stack.
notes_zh: 受到来自玩家控制来源或肉山的伤害后4秒内无法获得能量。
对自身的伤害和生命流失伤害无法移除能量。
移动速度加成效果不会叠加。

items.description_en:
Active: Rite of Rumusque
You enter ghost form for 4 seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and -30% more vulnerable to magic damage.

Steal 6% movement speed from enemy heroes in 900 range every second. Movement speed steal lasts 2s.

Putrefaction Aura's effect is increased to 90%. All of the lost Health Restoration is redirected to you every second.

Passive: Putrefaction Aura
Reduces nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration by 30%.

Radius: 900
items.description_zh:
主动：鲁姆斯克仪式
进入鬼魂形态，持续4秒，对物理伤害免疫，但是无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加-30%。

每秒从900范围内的敌方英雄窃取6%移动速度。移动速度的窃取效果持续2秒。

腐化光环效果提升至90%。每秒所有减少的生命回复都会转移到身上。

被动：腐化光环
附近敌方英雄的生命回复减少30%。

作用范围：900
notes_en: Ghost form ends if you become Debuff Immune and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Putrefaction Aura does not redirect Health Restoration from enemy heroes that are at full health.
notes_zh: 如果在开启期间进入减益免疫状态，幽魂效果将会中止。如果在减益免疫状态下开启权杖将不会拥有幽魂效果。
和幽魂权杖以及升级物品共享冷却时间。
腐化光环不会转移满血敌方英雄的生命回复。

items.description_en:
Passive: Miasma
Attacks poison enemies, dealing 2.5% of the target's Max HP as Magical Damage per second for 3 seconds.

Passive: Polycephaly
Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 3 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects except for Miasma. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.
items.description_zh:
被动：瘴毒
攻击会使目标中毒，每秒造成目标2.5%最大生命值的魔法伤害，持续3秒。

被动：多头一体
远程攻击有30%的概率向非原攻击目标的前方120度角内、攻击距离+150距离内的最多3个附近敌人发射额外弹道。额外弹道造成20 + 75%普通攻击伤害，并且不会触发瘴毒除外的击中效果。主攻击造成20 + 100%普通攻击伤害。
notes_en: Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.
notes_zh: 来自金箍棒、魔龙枪和升级物品的攻击距离加成不会叠加。

items.description_en:
Passive: Salvo
20% of the mana used to cast abilities is recovered over 10 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：齐鸣
施放技能使用的20%魔法消耗会在10秒内恢复。

items.description_en:
Passive: Linger
30% of incoming damage is delayed over 5 seconds.
items.description_zh:
被动：延缓
承受伤害的30%会延迟到5秒内施加。

items.description_en:
Toggle: Transmogrify
Toggle to switch the contents of the Satchel between a pound of Feathers or Rocks.

Feathers: increase movement speed by 12 and distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.

Rocks: increase armor by 3 and decrease the distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by 30%.
items.description_zh:
切换：变幻
切换会使小包里的东西在羽毛和石头之间变换。

羽毛：移动速度提升12，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果提升30%。

石头：提升3点护甲，施加给佩戴者的强制位移效果减少30%。

items.description_en:
Passive: Enchant
Increases the bonuses of the item's Neutral Enchantment by 10%. Every time this item is crafted again the bonus is increased by 35%.
items.description_zh:
被动：附魔
使物品的中立附魔加成提升10%。每次重新打造这件物品都会使加成提升35%。

items.description_en:
Passive: Balance
Gain 7% spell mana cost reduction for every ability off cooldown and 6% spell amplification for every ability on cooldown.
items.description_zh:
被动：均衡
每个不在冷却的英雄技能提供7%魔法消耗降低，每个在冷却的技能提供6%技能增强。
notes_en: Only considers abilities that are visible and have a cooldown.
notes_zh: 只会计算可见的技能和拥有冷却时间的技能。

items.description_en:
Passive: Spellover
Dealing 200 spell damage to an enemy causes them to overheat and deal damage to their allies in a 300 unit radius. Hero targets deal 80 damage to their allies, other targets deal 20 damage.
items.description_zh:
被动：法术外溢
对一个敌人造成200点技能伤害就会对其附近300范围内的友军造成伤害。英雄目标对其友军造成80点伤害，其他目标造成20点伤害。
notes_en: Spellover has a 0.1s cooldown between overheats.
Accumulated damage resets if no damage is dealt to the target for 6s.
notes_zh: 法术外溢现在拥有0.1秒的触发冷却时间。
累计的伤害在目标6秒内未受到伤害后重置。

items.description_en:
Passive: Forage
When the cooldown is ready, nearby trees that can be foraged will appear. By standing next to a tree for 0.75s, you can forage the tree and find flora, fungi or a bag of gold containing 30 gold.
items.description_zh:
被动：采菌
这件物品不在冷却时，附近能采到蘑菇的树木就会出现。在这样的树木旁站0.75秒后就能采到植物、蘑菇或包含30金的金袋。

items.description_en:
Use: Munch
Grants 1% max health regeneration to the target for 10 seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
items.description_zh:
使用：咀嚼
向目标提供1%秒最大生命值恢复，持续10秒。

受到敌方英雄或肉山攻击时效果会被驱散。
notes_en: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.
notes_zh: 按住Ctrl键点击附近友方英雄可以对其使用。

items.description_en:
Use: Munch
Grants 1 permanent primary attribute.
items.description_zh:
使用：咀嚼
永久获得1点主属性。
notes_en: Universal heroes get 0.4 bonus to all attributes.
notes_zh: 全才英雄获得0.4点额外全属性。

items.description_en:
Use: Munch
Instantly restores 50 mana + 5% of the target's max mana when consumed
items.description_zh:
使用：咀嚼
消耗后立刻回复50 + 5%目标最大魔法值的魔法。
notes_en: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.
notes_zh: 按住Ctrl键点击附近友方英雄可以对其使用。

notes_en: AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.
notes_zh: 来自魔龙枪和升级物品的攻击距离加成不会叠加。

items.description_en:
Passive: Brand
Increases spell damage dealt to player controlled targets by 9%.
items.description_zh:
被动：烙印
对玩家控制目标造成的技能伤害提升9%。
notes_en: Player controlled targets includes heroes and any creep summoned or converted by them.
notes_zh: 玩家控制目标包括英雄和他们召唤和劝化的所有非英雄单位。

items.description_en: Yummy Fish
items.description_zh: 可口的鱼

items.description_en: Activate to redeem a Tier 1 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.
items.description_zh: 使用后兑换一件第1级中立物品。兑换后的中立物品无法共享，而且每名英雄每一级代币只能兑换一枚。

items.description_en: Activate to redeem a Tier 2 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.
items.description_zh: 使用后兑换一件第2级中立物品。兑换后的中立物品无法共享，而且每名英雄每一级代币只能兑换一枚。

items.description_en: Activate to redeem a Tier 3 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.
items.description_zh: 使用后兑换一件第3级中立物品。兑换后的中立物品无法共享，而且每名英雄每一级代币只能兑换一枚。

items.description_en: Activate to redeem a Tier 4 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.
items.description_zh: 使用后兑换一件第4级中立物品。兑换后的中立物品无法共享，而且每名英雄每一级代币只能兑换一枚。

items.description_en: Activate to redeem a Tier 5 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.
items.description_zh: 使用后兑换一件第5级中立物品。兑换后的中立物品无法共享，而且每名英雄每一级代币只能兑换一枚。

items.description_en:
Passive: Vengeance
Provides 30 damage if equipped hero is Silenced and 20 armor if equipped hero is Stunned.
items.description_zh:
被动：复仇
装备的英雄被沉默时提供30点攻击力，被眩晕时提供20点护甲。

items.description_en:
Passive: Boldness
Grants 20 attack speed as long as there are enemy heroes within 1200 units.
items.description_zh:
被动：英勇
1200范围内只要有敌方英雄就提供20 攻击速度。

items.description_en:
Passive: Magical Damage Block
Every 12s, blocks up to 300 magic damage from damage instances over 75 damage.
items.description_zh:
被动：魔法伤害抵挡
每隔12秒抵挡300点魔法伤害，只抵挡超过75点的伤害

items.description_en:
Active: Martyrdom
Redirect 25% of all magic damage dealt to your allied heroes within 900 radius towards you for 10 seconds.
items.description_zh:
主动：殉道
将900范围内友方英雄所受魔法伤害的25%转嫁到自己身上，持续10秒。
notes_en: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

items.description_en:
Passive: Sixth Sense
Automatically dodge an attack from an enemy hero.
items.description_zh:
被动：第六感
自动躲避来自一名英雄的下次攻击。

items.description_en:
Use: Eat Lotus
Instantly restores 125 health and mana.
items.description_zh:
使用：吞食莲花
立刻回复125点生命和魔法。
notes_en: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.
notes_zh: 按住Ctrl键点击附近友方英雄可以对其使用。

items.description_en:
Use: Eat Lotus
Instantly restores 400 health and mana.
items.description_zh:
使用：吞食莲花
立刻回复400点生命和魔法。
notes_en: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.
notes_zh: 按住Ctrl键点击附近友方英雄可以对其使用。

items.description_en:
Use: Eat Lotus
Instantly restores 900 health and mana.
items.description_zh:
使用：吞食莲花
立刻回复900点生命和魔法。
notes_en: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.
notes_zh: 按住Ctrl键点击附近友方英雄可以对其使用。

items.description_en:
Active: Honor the Dead
Place this Offering on an Altar to honor the dead with a memory from those they left behind.
items.description_zh:
主动：纪念死者
把这个祭品放到祭坛上，获得生者的回忆来向死者致敬。
items.lore_en: Take joy in remembering those beloved who've passed now beyond the veil.
items.lore_zh: 回忆已穿过生死之界的挚爱，给自己一点欣慰。

items.description_en:
Active: Dig
Search the map for Offerings to the dead.
items.description_zh:
主动：挖掘
搜索地图去寻找给死者的祭品。
items.lore_en: You don't know where it came from, but it knows where you need to go. All you need to do is dig.
items.lore_zh: 你不知道它来自何处，但它知道你需要去哪。你需要的就是挖掘。

items.description_en:
Active: Undying Promise
Signal to the spirits of the other realm your commitment to honoring them. If everyone in the battle makes an Undying Promise before the fight begins, the dead might be willing to listen.
items.description_zh:
主动：永世诺言
通知其他世界的灵魂，承诺会悼念他们。如果战斗中所有人都在比赛开始前做出永世诺言，往生者也许会愿意聆听。
items.lore_en: This item seems unstable. Like it might just disappear.
items.lore_zh: 这件物品看起来不稳定。仿佛很快就会消失。
